subject: Money
title: Value Added Tax
description: Learn Value Added Tax in one minute.

hook.text: In Germany, the price on the shelf includes 19% VAT. You never see the tax added at checkout.

buildup.text: VAT is collected at every production stage. The farmer, miller, baker, and store each pay tax on their added value.

discovery.text: Over 170 countries use VAT. The U.S. is the only major economy without one.

twist.text: VAT is harder to evade than sales tax because every link in the chain reports the previous link's tax.

climax.text: VAT raises enormous revenue efficiently. But like sales tax, it's regressive without exemptions.

quiz.question: How does VAT differ from a regular sales tax?
options: It's collected at every stage of production
